blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: An image that is hard to classify on its own may have a helpful neighbor in the same unlabeled batch. Zero-shot vision-language models (VLMs) score images independently and leave this evidence unused. We study small unlabeled query batches with no labeled examples. Visual similarity can reflect pose or background, so it may connect images from different classes. Each image's scores over the class vocabulary offer another way to choose neighbors. We introduce Behavioral Affinity Transduction (BAT), which builds a sparse graph from these class-response profiles. The graph supplies neighbor evidence during prediction. For EM-Dirichlet, it also screens candidate classes and initializes assignments. BAT plugs into direct and iterative readouts of a frozen VLM. Across diverse datasets, BAT improves the mean accuracy of every tested readout. In the main RN50 comparison, soft and hard EM-Dirichlet gain $4.22$ and $2.72$ percentage points.
blocks.zh: 一个很难单独分类的图像可能在同一没有标签的批次中有一个有帮助的邻居. 零镜头视觉语言模型(VLMs)对图像进行独立分分,并留下这些证据未被使用. 我们研究没有标签的小型查询批次,没有标签的例子。 视觉相似性可以反映姿势或背景,因此可以连接不同类的图像. 每个图像的分数超过类词汇提供了另一种选择邻居的方法. 我们介绍了行为无穷转移(BAT),它从这些类反应剖面中构建出一个稀有的图. 该图在预测时提供相邻证据. 对于EM-Dirichlet,它也筛选候选班级并初始化分配. BAT插件直接并迭接地读取被冻结的VLM. 在整个不同的数据集中,最佳可得技术提高了每次测试的读出的平均准确度. 在RN50主比较中,软硬EM-Dirichlet获得4.22美元和2.72分.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Consider a small album of pet photos. One beagle is partly hidden by a blanket, while another is clearly visible. A terrier in the same room may resemble the hidden beagle more because of the background. A zero-shot vision-language model (VLM) such as CLIP scores each photo against breed names independently [ 14 ] . The clear beagle could help label the hidden one if the model knew which photos to compare. Video clips and photo collections often provide such unlabeled groups. Transductive inference uses the group to refine predictions jointly.
blocks.zh: 想想一张宠物相片的小相册 一个贝格尔被被被被毯子所部分隐藏,而另一个则明显可见. 同一个房间里的恐怖者可能因为背景而更像隐藏的猎人. CLIP等零镜头视觉语言模型(VLM)对相片每张相片进行分分,独立对应品种名 [14]. 如果模型知道要比较哪些照片,清晰的贝格尔可以帮助标记隐藏的贝格. 视频剪辑和相片集往往提供这种无标签的组. 转导推论利用该组共同完善预测.

blocks.en: Figure 1: OxfordPets visual and response t-SNE projections.
blocks.zh: 图1:OxfordPets视觉和反应t-SNE预测.

blocks.en: We study one unlabeled batch of N = 75 N=75 images with a frozen VLM and the full class vocabulary. There are no labeled support images or other test samples. EM-Dirichlet fits class distributions to batch responses [ 11 ] , and StatA adapts to the classes present [ 19 ] . These methods estimate class usage across the batch. A difficult image still needs relevant peers. TransCLIP uses visual affinities [ 20 ] . ZLaP and ECALP propagate labels on image-text graphs [ 17 , 8 ] , with ZLaP’s transductive version using the full test set. In a batch of 75 75 , a misplaced edge can pass evidence from the wrong image.
blocks.zh: 我们研究一批没有标记的N=75 N=75的图像,其中含有被冻结的VLM和完整的类词汇. 没有标签支持图像或其他测试样本. EM-Dirichlet适合分批响应的分级分布[11],而StatA则适应目前的分级[19]. 这些方法估计了整个批次的类用量. 一个困难的形象仍然需要相关的同行。 TransCLIP使用视觉亲和 [20]. ZLAP和ECALP在图像-文本图上宣传标签[17,8],ZLAP的转录版使用全测试集. 在7575的批量中,错误的边缘可以传递出错误图像中的证据.

blocks.en: Occlusion can separate the beagles in visual space. Their scores over the same breed names may still agree. Figure 1 shows this pattern on OxfordPets. BAT uses the full class response to find images with similar plausible labels and joins them in a sparse graph.
blocks.zh: 闭塞可以在视觉空间中分出被子. 他们在同一品种名上的得分可能仍然一致。 图1在OxfordPets上显示了这种模式. BAT使用全类响应来找到带有相近可信标签的图像并加入到一个稀有的图中.

blocks.en: BAT fits between the frozen VLM and a readout, as Fig. 2 shows. It builds one graph from cached class responses, then gathers neighboring assignments into a class message at each step. Direct prediction uses the message to revise scores. Iterative readouts use it to update assignments. EM-Dirichlet also uses the graph to screen candidate classes and initialize assignments. The encoders and class prototypes stay fixed, making BAT a plug-and-play module.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,BAT在被冻结的VLM和读出之间相匹配. 它从缓存的类响应中构建出一幅图表,然后在每个步骤上将相邻的任务收集成一个类信息. 直接预测使用消息修改分数. 迭代读取用来更新任务. EM-Dirichlet也使用图表来筛选候选类别并初始化任务. 编码器和类原型保持固定,使BAT成为了插座和游戏模块.

blocks.en: We make three contributions. • We build a sparse graph from class responses to link images with shared category evidence. • BAT shares one graph across seven readouts of a frozen VLM as a plug-and-play module. • At N = 75 N=75 , all seven readouts gain mean accuracy on ten datasets. Response graphs also outperform visual graphs for EM-Dirichlet.
blocks.zh: • 我们作出三项贡献。 我们从分类反应中绘制出一个稀少的图表,将图像与共同类别证据联系起来。 • 最佳可得技术在冷冻VLM的七个版本中共用一个图,作为插件和游戏模块。 在N = 75 N = 75 时,所有七个读取器在10个数据集上均获得平均精度. 反应图也优于EM-Dirichlet的视觉图.

blocks.en: 3.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Across ten datasets, BAT raises soft EM-Dirichlet from 68.99 % 68.99\% to 73.21 % 73.21\% and hard EM-Dirichlet from 70.69 % 70.69\% to 73.41 % 73.41\% (Table 1 ). Both improve on every dataset. The largest soft gains occur on Cars ( 6.09 6.09 points), Pets ( 6.06 6.06 ), and ImageNet ( 5.59 5.59 ). The gains include fine-grained datasets and the broader ImageNet task.
blocks.zh: 在10个数据集中,最佳可得技术将软EM-Dirichlet从68.99% 68.99%提高到73.21% 73.21%,而硬EM-Dirichlet从70.69% 70.69%提高到73.41% 73.41%(表1)。 两者都改进了每个数据集. 最大的软收益出现在汽车(6.09 6.09分),宠物(6.06 6.06分)和ImageNet(5.59 5.59分)上. 这些成果包括精细的数据集和更广泛的ImageNet任务.

blocks.en: 3.3 Readouts and Backbones
blocks.zh: 3.3 阅读和后骨

blocks.en: All seven readouts gain mean accuracy at N = 75 N=75 (Table 2 ). K-means and Gaussian readouts benefit most as graph messages guide assignments. EM-Dirichlet gains 4.07 4.07 and 2.59 2.59 points. With ViT-L/14, soft and hard BAT reach 81.71 % 81.71\% and 81.83 % 81.83\% (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 所有7个读出均以N=75 N=75得到平均准确度(表2)。 K- 意指和高斯读取最有益处, 作为图信息指导任务. EM-Dirichlet获得4.07 4.07和2.59 2.59分. 通过Vit-L/14,软和硬的最佳可得技术达到81.71%、81.83%、81.83%(表3)。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: Each image’s class response helps identify useful neighbors in an unlabeled batch. BAT turns their assignments into evidence for seven readouts of a frozen VLM. At N = 75 N=75 , the response graph selects more same-label neighbors than a visual graph, and every readout gains mean accuracy across ten datasets.
blocks.zh: 每个图像的类响应有助于在未加标签的批次中识别有用的邻居. 最佳可得技术将其任务转化为7次冷冻VLM读取的证据. 在 N = 75 N = 75 时,响应图选择的同标签邻比比可视图多,每个读出得分均指十套数据集的精度.
